criteria: People who carried out a substantial period of their political activity as socialists outside the Bolshevik/communist tradition: Mensheviks, right and centre Socialist Revolutionaries, the Bund, Plekhanov's Emancipation of Labour, Second International social democrats and labour parties (SPD, USPD, SFIO, British Labour, Finnish SDP, PSI, PSOE, PPS etc.) and democratic socialists. A later change of course (e.g. joining a communist party) does not remove the earlier period. Excludes Bolsheviks and communists whose socialist career was essentially communist, Left SRs and anarchists (separate collections), historians who merely studied these movements, liberals, and people only briefly or nominally members. Strict reading (operator, 2026-10-01): people who went on to found or lead a communist party or to serve a communist party-state are excluded even when their earlier social-democratic period was long.
